title: COMPL-AI Framework: A Technical Interpretation and LLM Benchmarking Suite for the EU Artificial Intelligence Act

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in the likelihood of a pair of sensitive statements differing by race (RedditBias), and evaluating movie recommendation consistency when modifying the user's race in the prompt (FaiRLLM).

Assessing demographic parity and equalized odds in income classification with respect to sex (DecodingTrust), analyzing gender polarity in open-ended text completions (BOLD), and measuring recommendation consistency across genders (FaiRLLM).

Evaluating the tendency of the model to rely on prejudiced stereotypes in ambiguous question-answering contexts (BBQ), and measuring movie recommendation consistency when modifying the user's religion in the prompt (FaiRLLM).
Measuring the consistency of the model's movie recommendations when the user's age is modified in the prompt description (FaiRLLM).
Measuring recommendation consistency when modifying the user's description to include different countries or continents (FaiRLLM).
Measuring the consistency of model recommendations across different user occupations (FaiRLLM).
